###############################################################
# German Rework Expansion — characters
#
# Eric Zemmour is defined here WITH a country_leader role on
# the despotism (neutrality) sub-ideology. That makes him a
# valid neutrality leader candidate for Germany from game start.
#
# He doesn't take over the active leader slot at game start —
# vanilla's auto-generated despotism leader keeps it. Zemmour
# becomes the active leader only when GER_a_new_hero finishes
# and calls promote_character on him.
#
# This is safe because we are NOT overriding vanilla GER.txt.
# Our file lives at common/characters/german_rework_characters.txt
# and merges with vanilla rather than replacing it, so all
# vanilla German characters (Hitler, Himmler, etc.) remain
# defined and the bookmark / Conflict Risk / leader cache
# systems on day 1 stay healthy.
###############################################################

characters = {

	GER_eric_zemmour = {
		name = GER_eric_zemmour
		portraits = {
			civilian = {
				large = "GFX_Portrait_Eric_Zemmour"
			}
		}
		country_leader = {
			ideology = despotism
			traits = { }
			expire = "1965.1.1"
			id = -1
		}
	}

}
